text: delivery 0x9e06f05bb982b549 | I'll compute the SHA-256 of the note text after the separator locally, then write the deliverable. Bash { "command": "printf '%s' \"difficulty=easy. Deliverable=150-300 characters signed in the derived deal room, stating the exact hash and PASS/FAIL.
